aboutUs:
T-Racers is the official racing team of Tanta University, competing in the global Formula Student series. Operating as a specialized division of MEC, the team brings together a multidisciplinary workforce to research, design, manufacture, and test high-performance formula-style race cars.

By integrating complete vehicle development with rigorous operational and testing procedures, T-Racers replicates a professional motorsport engineering environment. The team’s objective is to achieve top overall rankings in international competitions through continuous technical iteration, data-driven optimization, and manufacturing excellence.
vision: To establish Tanta University as a hub for automotive innovation, inspiring the next generation of Egyptian engineers to compete globally.
mission: To design and build competitive Formula Student cars, develop our members’ engineering and teamwork skills, and represent Egypt at international competitions such as Formula Student.
